note:
Ten localization modules ported from the 19.0 mirror. +3, all in the Polish pair: l10n_pl_bank_verification._l10n_pl_get_verification (23), l10n_pl_edi._l10n_pl_edi_get_xml_values (26) and .l10n_pl_edi_get_ksef_bill_vals_from_xml (22).

Banked rather than refactored. Each is a single long branch over a government EDI schema (KSeF, and the bank-account whitelist), where the complexity IS the schema: splitting one means deciding which fields group together, and this checkout has no test for any of them to hold that decision still. A refactor made blind to the format is a worse trade than a floor that names the three.
